name: Destiny Linnet
source:
The matriarch of the Linnet family, Destiny owns and is the lead designer of Dress Me Down—Vesper's premier fashion center. She's a woman who knows what she wants, and she couples that knowledge with her domineering personality and years of experience to get it.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
